tests: disabled recovery rejects reconnect but cancellation waits for physical close
live connection reconnect is a no-op and many callers do not dial
live channel reconnect replays topology without replacing the physical channel
live channel replay preserves active consumers without a duplicate subscription
explicit callers join automatic connection recovery and preserve channels
retry exhaustion retains configured flags, clears topology and settles cancellation
explicit retry after exhaustion starts a new usable lifecycle with fresh notification
failed explicit retry rejects and can be retried again within the same configured policy
closing during backoff settles notifications and rejects all joined reconnect calls
destroy or external abort permanently prevents resurrection after exhaustion
cancellation observation does not cancel recovery and listeners remain bounded
explicit close wins when reconnect is called from a terminal close observer
single-channel automatic recovery is joined and a sibling remains usable
closed channel reconnect rejects without recreating its owner records
scope: Recovery control and cancellation fixtures, including exhaustion, lifecycle restart, active replay, joining, bounded observation and close/abort races. Native and real broker comparisons are separate.
